headline: Mahindra Finance Denies Plans to Acquire Gold Loan Companies
summary: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services issued a clarification denying media reports that it is pursuing the acquisition of any gold finance company.
why: Mahindra Finance is a major Indian non-banking financial company specializing in rural and semi-urban lending.

impacts.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services
impacts.why: Clarification dispels acquisition speculation surrounding near-term balance sheet expansion.
